ambiguity: The text says destruction is irreversible and asks Miriam to 'note the irreversible disposition', but never says what is lost (e.g. the only copies of family letters) or that the family would suffer. That is general irreversibility, not an explicit statement of irreversible loss to the family, so I coded it 'mentioned'. The remedy is borderline: the five requests are listed as 'unresolved for the next approval review', which invites later review, but nobody is asked to stop the destruction, and it is unclear whether the 'please note' counts as a review request.

quotes.primary_reason: Under OPS-14, the booking/request does not change its date or remove it from the manifest
